+### FIN-03.03 — One transaction form — the type a dropdown, then field and timeline
+
+**Statement.** A person records a transaction on ONE form: its TYPE (Deposit · Withdrawal) from the first dropdown, then the amount, the day and time (CST), the SECTION A–M, the FIELD within it, the LENGTH — the MoT — from one dropdown of presets (One time · Weekly · 30.333 days the pay MoT · Every 33 days · Monthly (91) · Yearly · Other, where Other is a number in years · days · hours · minutes), and a memo; one button whose word follows the type; a withdrawal is refused on hold or insufficient funds exactly as before; the entry carries its field and timeline inside its chain hash.
